tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Pinoyshki Bakery's menu with prices and photos, from the bakery's live data. lane 'today' is today's counter menu (what can be ordered on Toast for pickup today or a later day; sold-out items are left off); lane 'catering' is the catalogue for ordering 3 days to a week ahead, with sizes (full-size, bite-size dozen, half dozen).

section.description: Optional section filter, like 'Pastries' or 'Vegan'. 'Piroshki' and 'Pinoyshki' both show the whole family (pinoyshki are piroshki with Filipino fillings); customers asking for either nearly always want both.

only_this_family.description: Only when the customer asked for just piroshki or just pinoyshki: keep the section filter to that word.

tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Find menu items by a few words (a filling, a pastry, 'vegan', 'ube'), across today's counter menu and catering. Each match comes with its price, a short description, a photo URL and the allergens the bakery lists. Custom cakes are not in it; they are designed with cake_options.

query.description: A few words to look for.

tools.name: show_item
tools.description: One menu item with its photo, description, sizes and prices, and the allergens the bakery lists. The photo is included in the result.

tools.name: cake_options
tools.description: Custom decorated cakes for any occasion (a birthday, anniversary, graduation, baby shower, retirement, holiday or office party): the cake sizes and prices (with candles and a card), flavors, the earliest day, what the bakery does not make, photos of past cakes, and the design questions to settle. A cake is ordered through check_order with its cake details.

guests.description: Optional: how many people, to suggest a size.

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to order: checks a basket of one or more menu items against the bakery's ordering rules. Saves nothing and makes no link. Returns the lane (same day on Toast, or catering on Shopify), the priced lines, the subtotal, any problems, and the dates and times the bakery can serve. Rules it applies: closed Mondays and blocked dates; Toast = only counter-menu items, up to 6 piroshki and pinoyshki (other items not limited), pickup, today while open or scheduled up to 14 days ahead with a time in that day's hours; catering = 3 days' notice for up to 24 full-size or 4 dozen bite-size piroshki and pinoyshki (other items not limited, pickup), a week ahead (by Saturday) for more, any delivery and custom cakes; delivery within 15 miles on orders over $100 or with a cake of $75 or more. The result may list 'Still needed' questions: combo_offer (a combo, in combo hours), sold_out_choice (what to do if a piroshki is sold out, for a later day) and cake_details (what is still undecided about a custom cake).

items.description: What to order. Use item names exactly as get_menu or search_menu gave them.

size.description: Catering sizes: 'full' (default), 'dozen', 'half dozen' or 'individual' (bite-size). Same-day items are always 'full'.

note.description: Optional note for this line, like a cake inscription.

if_unavailable.description: Toast orders, piroshki and pinoyshki only: what the bakery does if this one is sold out when the order is made. 'closest' (default) swaps in the closest piroshki, 'remove' leaves it out, 'cancel' cancels the order. Worth asking for a scheduled day, since the counter menu changes.

backups.description: Toast orders, with if_unavailable 'closest': up to 3 counter-menu piroshki or pinoyshki the customer would take instead, in order of preference.

combo.description: Toast orders, piroshki and pinoyshki, when the pickup time is in combo hours (Tue to Fri, 11 am to 4 pm): 'small' = fries + a 12oz drink, 'large' = large fries, borscht + a drink, 'none' = the customer said no. check_order offers it (combo_offer) with each item's prices and drinks.

combo_drink.description: The combo's drink, as check_order listed it (like '12oz Coke' or 'Small Juice'). Default: any 12oz soda.

cake.description: Only on the decorated cake (see cake_options): what was decided with the customer. Leave out what is not decided yet.

guests.description: How many people; picks the size.

flavor.description: One of cake_options' premade flavors, or the custom flavor asked for (vanilla, red velvet, ube...), which goes to the bakery to confirm.

recipient.description: Who it is for (with their age, for a birthday).

design.description: The design concept the customer agreed to.

card.description: A card to go with the cake.

channel.description: Optional. 'today' = the counter menu on Toast: same day, or a scheduled pickup up to 14 days ahead (up to 6 full-size, pickup only, paid on Toast); 'catering' = ordered 3 or more days ahead, paid on Shopify. Left out, the basket and date decide: catering is preferred from 3 days out when every item is on the catering menu.

fulfillment.description: Default pickup. Delivery is catering, week-ahead only.

date.description: The date as YYYY-MM-DD ('today' also works). Work it out from the customer's words using today's date in Seattle (Pacific time). If their words could mean two dates, like 'next Friday' said earlier in the same week, ask them which before calling. Needed for catering and for a Toast pickup on a later day.

time.description: 12-hour time like '1:00 pm'. Needed for catering and for a Toast pickup on a later day.

zip.description: Delivery ZIP code (delivery is within 15 miles).

staff_tip.description: Toast orders: the tip for the bakery staff in whole dollars, shared by the staff who bake, pack and hand over the order. 0 (the default) unless the customer picks one; offer $1, $3 or $5 or any whole amount.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Step 2 of 2 to order, for a basket check_order has allowed: checks the same order again and returns the link the customer pays on, on the bakery's own domain. The same order sent again within 15 minutes gets the same link back; an empty basket gets no link. Toast: a Pinoyshki page that shows the order while it finishes the cart on Toast (with the staff tip and the pickup day and time), then takes them to Toast's checkout (good for a week; opened after its pickup time it remakes the cart for the next pickup time). Catering: it checks the order again and opens Shopify's checkout with the date, time and pickup or delivery filled in (good for a week). No payment happens here. If a rule is broken it returns the problems instead of a link.
